title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard
workpass: 14 — UI regression isolation and browser smoke baseline enforcement
method: Retains WorkPass 7 fixed weights; updates only workstreams whose implementation evidence changed. This is estimated weighted implementation progress, not release readiness. Task counts below use a normalized, non-duplicated inventory of current deliverables, not the append-only historical tasklist. WorkPass14 changes only workstream B based on a previously failing 8-test environment-contamination cluster being made hermetic and a baseline comparator regression defect being closed. Full browser execution remains unverified.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: No duplicate canonical owner; source manifests and metadata contract reconciled.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Static runtime routes and smoke remain healthy; WorkPass14 made PWA tests hermetic and browser smoke baseline regression detection fail closed. Full app dependency-complete tests/build and actual browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: Retrieval determinism, complete fingerprints, offline runner and confidence gates are implemented; real labeled temporal holdout is still absent.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: Core execution and targeted feedback links exist; full critical-path and external-observer stress remains partial.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: Experiment infrastructure is stronger, but no real-corpus uplift or research promotion is evidenced.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Version/metadata and archive evidence improved; app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room drill and soak remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Status counts classify 42 normalized deliverables. PARTIAL is not half-complete in every instance; half-credit is only a comparison aid.

openReleaseGates: Complete agency loop: competition → action → verified outcome → persistence → reafference

Portable subject continuity and behavioral fidelity
Capability evidence graph for critical user journeys
External delivery receipts, reconnect and provider replay guarantees
Clean-room backup/restore, migration and rollback drill
Research candidates from NeuroCore/NOMEGA/DeepCode and external adapters
Authorization/abuse/rate-limit review for new diagnostic/benchmark APIs
Real independently labelled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout
Dependency-complete app install and full root/app typecheck
Desktop/mobile browser E2E, including interactive Live2D

environmentNote: App script tests pass 203/203, but full `npm --prefix app test` cannot finish its TypeScript unit stage because dependencies @tanstack/react-start and jose are unavailable in this source-only environment. npm registry DNS failure EAI_AGAIN prevented clean install; no React/Vite build or browser E2E is claimed.
limitations: No real independently labelled temporal corpus; synthetic fixtures are not production uplift evidence.
Root/app clean typecheck and React/Vite production build remain unverified.
Browser/mobile/Live2D E2E, clean-room restore/upgrade/rollback, multi-hour soak and final SBOM/provenance sign-off remain open.
PWA app unit tests now use isolated workspaces; this fixes environment contamination in tests, not a production site identity change.
Browser-smoke baseline comparison logic is unit-tested, but Playwright browser run itself was not possible without installed app/playwright dependencies.
Do not count app UI build or browser E2E as complete until a dependency-complete environment executes them.
